key_impacts: At least five million people affected
Many hospitals and health centres destroyed or damaged
Water supplies and sanitation systems damaged/contaminated
evidence_snippets: On 26 December 2004 a massive earthquake…triggered a powerful tsunami.
The death toll exceeded 280,000…more than one million persons were displaced.
In Indonesia…good information was available for Banda Aceh…assessments along the otherwise inaccessible west coast of Aceh.
missing_information: Most affected sub-national locations outside Indonesia not specified

evidence_snippets: Continuing seismic activity… the 28 March quake affecting Nias and neighbouring islands off Sumatra.
